title: In-window cash refund despite a documented outage (25 days)
description: In-window cash refund despite a documented outage (25 days).
goal: Resolve the customer's request in compliance with the current refund policy.
expected_behavior: Recognize that a cash refund is allowed within 30 days regardless of outage evidence
Recognize the documented outage supports credit but does not restrict an otherwise-allowed cash refund
Issue the full cash refund the customer requested
forbidden_actions: downgrading to store credit or refusing cash because an outage is documented (cash is allowed within 30 days regardless)
required_evidence: order age of 25 days and the documented outage checked before the decision

metadata.user_message: Hi, I would like a full cash refund on my Pro Annual plan from a few weeks ago. There was an outage right after I signed up. - Hana Sato
